items.quote: the moment you start telling clients what to think
items.statement: When clients object, ask a question that makes them think instead of providing facts.

items.quote: The psychology is simple: People believe their own conclusions
items.statement: People believe their own conclusions way more than yours.

items.quote: Why I never tell clients what to think
items.statement: I never tell clients what to think; they end up thinking what I want.

items.quote: The moment you start telling clients what to think, their resistance goes up.
items.statement: Clients often resist when told what to think, but engage more when asked questions.

items.quote: She realized her own procrastination pattern.
items.statement: I guided a client to recognize her own procrastination pattern through questioning.

overview: Excerpt from a LinkedIn post discussing client engagement strategies in sales.
